statement: Multi-city Or-opt (segments 1-3) with grid-guided insertion does not measurably improve score beyond single-city Or-opt for penalty-aware TSP at N=200K within 2s. The effect, if present, is below 0.2 points (~0.25% of score).
regime: penalty-aware TSP, N=200K, 2s time limit, grid-guided 2-opt + Or-opt SA baseline scoring ~78.8
mechanism: At the tour quality level achieved by grid-guided 2-opt + single-city Or-opt (~78.8), compound relocations of 2-3 cities rarely find improvements that single-city relocations miss. Grid-guided insertion targeting does not consistently select better positions than random shift, possibly because spatially-nearby cities are already tour-adjacent in a well-optimized tour.
applicability_bounds: Applies to the specific move mix (55/10/35), SA temp (curCost/N*3), and grid-guided insertion strategy tested. A different Or-opt targeting strategy (e.g., nearest-neighbor in tour order) or tighter segment size selection might yield different results.
